Another important milestone for

candidates.author: Peter Krauth
candidates.text:
Outcrop Silver 
@OCG_Silver
 keeps delivering at Santa Ana.

Nearly 3 kilometres of mineralized strike, another high-grade vein discovered, and importantly, more silver being found outside the current resource.

That's exactly what I want to see from a growing silver deposit.

candidates.author: Peter Krauth
candidates.text:
Now THIS is the kind of result that gets my attention.


@AbraSilver
  just delivered its best gold intercept ever at Oculto. And importantly, the higher-grade core sits outside the current resource.

This is more than just a great drill hole. It's potential for more ounces.

candidates.author: Lobo Tiggre
candidates.text:
The End of Gold?

I'm deeply skeptical that fusion creating rare isotopes with gold as a byproduct will work at a scale big enough to matter.

Theory is one thing. Real-world costs are another.

But if they do succeed, we'll see it coming as they pass milestones over the years...
